voice_note: v3 (Oct 21): photo homework check, the public web page as a real MCP client, and the same server in Claude Code. A string plays after any assistant reply; {pre, post} plays pre before the reply and post after it. Target total 2:45-2:55.

scenes.02-why: Over half of U.S. teens use AI chatbots for schoolwork, and four in ten for math. A chatbot sounds just as sure when it's wrong, so a parent can't tell a confident wrong answer from a right one. What if Alexa had to prove it?

03-photo.pre: This is Show Your Work: an Alexa+ skill built as a self-hosted MCP server, here on a simulated Alexa+ display. Maya's dad shows Alexa her homework.
03-photo.post: Gemini only reads the page: each line, and where it is. Our MCP server does the math in exact fractions and finds the first line that changes the answer. x equals 5 works on line one, but not on line two. An independent verifier replayed that proof before Alexa said a word.

04-unclear.pre: When a line is unclear, the reader can flag it instead of guessing.
04-unclear.post: A flagged line is held for review. Nothing is concluded about it, and every other step is still checked.

05-typo.pre: Some worksheets can't be right as written.
05-typo.post: Twenty tickets for three hundred dollars forces minus twelve child tickets. That's a certified no, with a two-line proof.

scenes.06-forgery: Every result is an MCP App card. Replay re-runs the verifier. Try a forgery changes one number and recomputes the hash, and the verifier still rejects it.
scenes.07-web: Anyone can try it with no install. This public web page is a real MCP client: it calls initialize, tools list and tools call on our hosted server over Streamable HTTP. Then your own browser replays the certificate with an independent copy of the verifier.
scenes.08-claude: Because it's standard MCP, the same server works in other assistants. Here, Claude Code calls check work on the public endpoint and gets the same verified answer.

09-memory.pre: Alexa also makes practice problems with verified answer keys, and remembers progress.
09-memory.post: Every saved certificate is re-verified before it counts.

scenes.10-architecture: Under the hood: MCP 2025-11-25 over Streamable HTTP, an MCP Apps card, exact rational arithmetic, and a verifier that never imports the compiler.
scenes.11-close: For parents, tutors and teachers: AI reads. The compiler calculates. The verifier certifies.
